name: German health insurance guide and recommendation tool

mentions.name: German health insurance guide and recommendation tool
mentions.description: This guide and interactive tool helps immigrants pick German health insurance. The guide offers clear, succinct advice without oversimplifying, written with help from competing insurance experts and addressing the specific needs of immigrants. The advice is also turned into an interactive recommendation tool that gives people clear, specific advice in a few seconds, and connects readers to a vetted broker through an affiliate partnership structured to incentivise honesty and neutrality.
mentions.problem: Existing information about German health insurance is mostly blogspam from non-experts trying to make a quick buck, recommending only the two brands with an affiliate program, and finding an honest broker is difficult.
mentions.audience: Immigrants to Germany who need to choose between public and private German health insurance.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I wrote a better guide with help from competing insurance experts. The information is clear and succinct without oversimplifying things. It addresses the specific needs of immigrants.

Then I turned the advice into an interactive recommendation tool. People get clear, specific advice in a few seconds.
